name: Resistance Network

platform.name: Resistance Network (native Layer 1)
platform.contract_address: native (no contract — RSTN is the native gas token of the RSTN L1)

circulating_supply_note: 50M bootstrap seed (verified testnet node operators). The remaining 950M is a non-circulating reserve distributed only via Proof of Participation staking rewards with 4-year halving. No minting — all 1B tokens exist from genesis block 0.
price_usd_note: Null until first DEX swap. RSTN has no sale, no ICO, no sale price. Price is born from market discovery at the first RSTN/USDC pool swap (block 0 fair launch, Satoshi model). CoinGecko/CoinMarketCap should read price from the DEX pool reserves via VWAP, not from this field.

dex.price_method: VWAP of pool reserves, queried on-chain by aggregator

distribution.mechanism: Earned by work. Staking rewards with 4-year halving. Team operates genesis validator and earns from this bucket (Satoshi model). Zero reserved team bucket.
Delivered once to verified testnet node operators. PoS equivalent of Satoshi's first miners. Not transferable to founders.
